The premise

Beast of Reincarnation is set in a post-apocalyptic Japan in the year 4026. Humanity's hope rests with two outcasts: Emma, shunned for an affliction she carries, and Koo, a blighted dog. Official copy frames their journey as both lonely and companionable, moving through a world where forests can burst to life amid wasteland and wither again.

Emma and Koo are tasked with battling Bosses, capturing their powers, and ultimately facing the being the game is named for - the Beast of Reincarnation. Steam also pitches a story where every character hides a dangerous truth.

Emma and Koo: the hybrid combat system

The headline mechanic is the bond between Emma and Koo. You fight as a unit: Emma handles sword combat while you issue commands to Koo. Game Freak describes this as a hybrid combat system that combines real-time action with turn-based RPG elements - the core difference from a straight Souls-like framing.

Builds and playstyles

Official materials highlight customization through skill trees, gear, and spirit stones. Steam calls out three broad loadout directions - ranged, stealthy, and aggressive - so players can define how they approach the world's Bosses.

PC system requirements

Steam currently lists Windows-only support, DirectX 12, 45 GB storage, and an SSD requirement.

Minimum

  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • CPU: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Notes: Low 1080p @ 40fps w/ DLSS or FSR1 (Performance). SSD required.

Recommended

  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • CPU: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Notes: Med 1080p @ 60fps w/ DLSS or FSR3 (Performance). SSD required.

Features, languages & editions

Steam lists full controller support (including DualShock / DualSense notes), Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud, adjustable difficulty, subtitle options, and family sharing. Supported languages include full audio for English and Japanese, with additional text languages listed on the store page.

Two purchase options currently appear on Steam: the standard edition at $59.99 and a Deluxe Edition at $69.99. Exact deluxe contents should be checked on the store page, as package art may change before launch.

Frequently asked questions

When does Beast of Reincarnation release?

Steam currently lists the release date as 3 August 2026 (coming soon). Pre-purchase is already live on the official Steam store.

Who is developing and publishing Beast of Reincarnation?

It is developed by GAME FREAK inc. and published by Fictions.

What platforms is Beast of Reincarnation on?

The Steam store page currently lists Windows PC support. Other storefront platforms are not confirmed on the Steam listing itself.

Is Beast of Reincarnation a Souls-like?

Not exactly. Official copy describes a hybrid combat system that fuses real-time action with turn-based RPG elements, built around Emma and Koo fighting as a unit.

How does the Emma and Koo combat system work?

Hybrid combat that combines real-time action with turn-based RPG elements: fight as a unit using Emma's sword abilities while commanding Koo to unleash techniques.

What are the PC system requirements?

Minimum: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB), 16 GB RAM, 45 GB SSD. Recommended: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB), 16 GB RAM, 45 GB SSD.

How much does Beast of Reincarnation cost on Steam?

Steam currently lists the standard edition at $59.99 and the Deluxe Edition at $69.99 (USD, no discount at last check).

Are the guides on this site confirmed?

Not yet. Strategy pages are pre-release previews built from official materials and expectations, not hands-on play. They are labeled speculation and kept noindex until verified after launch.
